params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox is riding the GTA 6 hype without ever saying its name Like plenty of big brands, Xbox is finding ways to tie itself to the biggest game launch of the year. But as Eurogamer points out, its campaigns cleverly avoid mentioning GTA 6 directly, a sharp contrast with indie publisher Devolver Digital, which has openly named the game in its own launch-day stunts. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 11:41 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @Xbox · @RockstarGames · @devolverdigital 😂 Clever marketing or awkward dodge?
